units.excerpt: You are Nico Lin. You work for World City Travel, a company which organises wildlife tours in Hong Kong and around the world. You are a secretary to the manager at World City Travel, Ms Avery Goh. Ms Goh has asked you to do some tasks.
units.zh: 你是Nico Lin。你在World City Travel工作，這是一間在香港及世界各地舉辦野生生態旅遊的公司。你是經理Avery Goh的秘書。 Avery Goh叫你處理一些工作。

units.excerpt: You will listen to a Zoom meeting between Ms Avery Goh, the CEO of World City Travel Mr Shane Lee, and biologist Dr David Atkinson.
units.zh: 你將收聽Avery Goh 、 World City Travel行政總裁Shane Lee，以及生物學家David Atkinson的Zoom會議。

units.excerpt: Before the recording is played, you will have five minutes to study the Question-Answer Book and the Data File to familiarise yourself with the situation and the tasks.
units.zh: 錄音播放前，考生有五分鐘閱讀問答簿及資料檔，以熟悉情境和任務。

units.excerpt: Complete the tasks by following the instructions in the Question-Answer Book and on the recording.
units.zh: 請按照問答簿及錄音中的指示完成任務。

units.excerpt: You will find all the information you need in the Question-Answer Book, the Data File and on the recording.
units.zh: 所需資料可在問答簿、資料檔及錄音中找到。

units.excerpt: As you listen you can make notes on Page 3 of the Data File.
units.zh: 聆聽時可在資料檔第 3 頁記筆記。

units.excerpt: You now have five minutes to familiarise yourself with the Question-Answer Book and the Data File.
units.zh: 你現在有五分鐘熟悉問答簿及資料檔。

units.excerpt: Email from Avery Goh to Nico Lin
units.zh: Avery Goh寄給Nico Lin的電郵

units.excerpt: To: Nico Lin / From: Avery Goh / Subject: Tasks for our Sydney tours / Sent: Saturday 13th April 10:05AM
units.zh: 收件人： Nico Lin ／寄件人： Avery Goh ／主旨：悉尼旅遊項目的工作／時間： 4月13日星期六上午10:05

units.excerpt: Hi Nico,
units.zh: Hi Nico,

units.excerpt: As you know, we run two main activities in Sydney, Australia that follow the big marine migration seasons: the Sydney Whale Watching Cruise held on a catamaran, and the Adventure Fishing Tour held on a luxury yacht.
units.zh: 如你所知，我們在澳洲悉尼有兩項主要活動，配合大型海洋遷徙季節進行：在雙體船上舉行的Sydney Whale Watching Cruise，以及在豪華遊艇上舉行的Adventure Fishing Tour。

units.excerpt: Things have not been great there recently due to the accident the World City Travel catamaran was involved in.
units.zh: 公司最近因雙體船意外而情況不佳。

units.excerpt: I need you to work on a number of tasks for me as we try to fix the fallout and move on.
units.zh: Avery 要 Nico 完成多項工作，以處理事故後續並讓公司向前走。

units.excerpt: First, complete the internal incident report for the catamaran accident.
units.zh: 首先，完成這宗雙體船意外的內部事故報告。

units.excerpt: I've attached the guidelines from the company handbook for what we include in incident reports, so start there.
units.zh: 我已附上公司手冊中關於incident report應包括甚麼的指引，所以先從那裡開始。

units.excerpt: It seems you've got all the other documents related to the accident.
units.zh: 看來你已經拿到與意外有關的其他文件。

units.excerpt: Moving on, I need you to write a follow-up email to the participants of the cancelled Sydney Whale Watching Cruise.
units.zh: 接著，我要你寫一封follow-up email給已取消的Sydney Whale Watching Cruise參加者。

units.excerpt: We've recently made quite a few decisions on what this should include — start by looking at Shane Lee's email to me.
units.zh: 我們最近已就這封電郵應包括甚麼作出不少決定——先看看Shane Lee寄給我的電郵。

units.excerpt: Finally, I need you to draft a script for a YouTube advertisement promoting the Adventure Fishing Tour.
units.zh: 最後，我要你起草一段YouTube廣告script，宣傳Adventure Fishing Tour。

units.excerpt: Make sure it sounds fun and exciting!
units.zh: 一定要令它聽起來好玩又刺激！

units.excerpt: We have spent a lot of money on a new luxury yacht for the tour, so I think our CEO will be happy if you explain how this will enhance the customer experience.
units.zh: 我們花了很多錢在這個tour的新豪華遊艇上，所以如果你能解釋這如何提升顧客體驗，我想CEO會很高興。

units.excerpt: The Sydney Times article mentioned the tour as well.
units.zh: Sydney Times那篇文章也提到這個tour。

units.excerpt: Also refer to the recording of the Zoom meeting between me, Shane Lee and Dr David Atkinson: we discussed all of the above.
units.zh: 另外，也請參考我、 Shane Lee和David Atkinson的Zoom會議錄音：我們討論了以上全部事情。

units.excerpt: Dr Atkinson sent me his SMS messages with Captain Moby, which should be useful for all of these tasks as well.
units.zh: Atkinson醫生把他與Captain Moby的短訊傳給我，這些對以上所有任務也應該有用。

units.excerpt: Thanks, / Avery Goh / World City Travel Manager
units.zh: 謝謝／ Avery Goh ／ World City Travel經理

units.excerpt: Transcript of radio communication between Captain Moby and control centre
units.zh: Captain Moby與控制中心的無線電通訊逐字稿

units.excerpt: Date: 27th March / Time: 4:37pm
units.zh: 日期： 3月27日／時間：下午4:37

units.excerpt: Control centre to Captain Moby.
units.zh: 控制中心呼叫 Moby 船長。

units.excerpt: How are you enjoying your day out?
units.zh: 今天出航愉快嗎？

units.excerpt: It's been smooth sailing so far.
units.zh: 到目前為止航行情況平穩。

units.excerpt: And sounds like you guys have some free time.
units.zh: 看來你們很有空。

units.excerpt: Just making sure our favourite captain is having fun.
units.zh: 只是想確認我們最喜歡的船長玩得開心。

units.excerpt: Seems like we have some static over the radio.
units.zh: 無線電似乎出現雜音。

units.excerpt: All good mate.
units.zh: 一切正常。

units.excerpt: I can still hear you.
units.zh: 我仍聽得到你。

units.excerpt: Date: 27th March / Time: 5:00pm
units.zh: 日期： 3月27日／時間：下午5:00

units.excerpt: Captain Moby to control.
units.zh: Moby 船長呼叫控制中心。

units.excerpt: We are currently in Sydney Harbour.
units.zh: 我們目前在悉尼港。

units.excerpt: How are conditions looking?
units.zh: 目前情況如何？

units.excerpt: Control centre to Captain Moby. We hear you.
units.zh: 控制中心回覆 Moby 船長並表示收到訊息。

units.excerpt: Traffic is low.
units.zh: 航道交通量低。

units.excerpt: Seems like some clouds are rolling in.
units.zh: 看來有雲層正在移入。

units.excerpt: We suggest you…
units.zh: 我們建議你……

units.excerpt: Please repeat instruction, control.
units.zh: 請控制中心重複指示。

units.excerpt: We suggest you wait it out.
units.zh: 我們建議你等待情況過去。

units.excerpt: That's good to know.
units.zh: 知道了。

units.excerpt: We will wait.
units.zh: 我們會等待。

units.excerpt: Over and out.
units.zh: 通訊完畢。

units.excerpt: Date: 27th March / Time: 5:50pm
units.zh: 日期： 3月27日／時間：下午5:50

units.excerpt: Captain Moby: Captain... to control centre. We are being pushed by... Losing... Over.
units.zh: Captain Moby： Captain……呼叫控制中心。我們正被……推動……失去……完畢。

units.excerpt: Try to regain control.
units.zh: 嘗試重新控制船隻。

units.excerpt: Keep the catamaran …
units.zh: 讓雙體船保持……

units.excerpt: Over.
units.zh: 完畢。

units.excerpt: No use, control.
units.zh: 沒有用，控制中心。

units.excerpt: The … are too …
We have crashed!
units.zh: 我們撞船了！

units.excerpt: 29th March
units.zh: 來自Sydney Times的新聞文章」 ／ 「3月29日

units.excerpt: Catamaran Caught by the Weather
units.zh: 雙體船被天氣困住／受天氣影響出事

units.excerpt: If you thought you were having a bad day, it probably wasn't as bad as the day World City Travel just experienced!
units.zh: 如果你以為你今天很倒楣，那大概也不及World City Travel剛經歷的一天那麼糟！

units.excerpt: A catamaran owned by World City Travel had a nasty mishap as it crashed on Wednesday evening.
units.zh: World City Travel擁有的一艘雙體船在星期三晚上發生嚴重意外並撞毀。

units.excerpt: Renowned for its luxury Sydney Whale Watching Cruise, World City Travel will be tasked with rescuing its reputation after the pride of its fleet crashed into rocks in the harbour.
units.zh: World City Travel以豪華悉尼賞鯨巡遊聞名，但其船隊主力在港內撞上岩石後，公司將要挽回聲譽。

units.excerpt: A spokesperson for World City Travel stated that due to the accident, participants of the next Sydney Whale Watching Cruise have been informed of its cancellation and that they will be provided with a full refund.
units.zh: World City Travel發言人表示，由於這宗意外，下一班Sydney Whale Watching Cruise的參加者已被通知取消，而他們將獲全額退款。

units.excerpt: Police were seen to be interviewing Captain Moby, who was in charge of the vessel at the time of the accident.
units.zh: 警方被目擊正在訪問事發時掌舵的 Moby 船長。

units.excerpt: They will be sure to take a look at any communications between the captain and the shore.
units.zh: 報章推測警方會查看船長與岸上的通訊。

units.excerpt: World City Travel is reported to be undertaking its own investigation in tandem.
units.zh: 據報 World City Travel 同時進行內部調查。

units.excerpt: Initial reports are that, ruling out human error, the accident was likely to have been caused by bad weather.
units.zh: 初步報告排除人為錯誤，認為事故很可能由惡劣天氣造成。

units.excerpt: The skies have generally been lovely and clear in the past few days.
units.zh: 過去數天天空大致晴朗。

units.excerpt: A sudden change in conditions was recorded in the area around the time of the crash.
units.zh: 撞船前後，該區錄得天氣突然轉變。

units.excerpt: Amidst all this negative publicity, World City Travel is also launching pre-booking for its Adventure Fishing Tour.
units.zh: 在負面報道期間，公司亦開始接受 Adventure Fishing Tour 預訂。

units.excerpt: The Adventure Fishing Tour will run from 15th November to 27th January.
units.zh: Adventure Fishing Tour 原先公布由 11 月 15 日至 1 月 27 日舉行。

units.excerpt: Will this have better luck? Only time will tell.
units.zh: 新團會否更幸運？只有時間能證明。

units.excerpt: In the meantime, enjoy the rest of the whale migration season!
units.zh: 與此同時，請好好享受餘下的鯨魚遷徙季節吧！

units.excerpt: Photo: The World City Travel catamaran before the crash
units.zh: 圖片： World City Travel的雙體船在撞船前

units.excerpt: 31st March
units.zh: David Atkinson與Captain Moby的短訊」 ／ 「3月31日

units.excerpt: Morning Moby! How are you these days?
units.zh: Moby，早晨！你近來好嗎？

units.excerpt: I'll be giving live commentary on the Adventure Fishing Tour.
units.zh: Atkinson 會在 Adventure Fishing Tour 提供現場講解。

units.excerpt: It's being held on my favourite yacht!
units.zh: 旅程會使用 Atkinson 最喜歡的遊艇。

units.excerpt: Oh wow!
units.zh: 噢，真厲害！

units.excerpt: I saw some drafts of the promotional materials.
units.zh: Moby 看過宣傳材料草稿。

units.excerpt: They only mention 'commentary by a famous biologist'.
units.zh: 草稿只寫了「由一位著名生物學家講解」。

units.excerpt: They should really add your name as well: use your star power!
units.zh: 宣傳應加入 Atkinson 的姓名，利用他的知名度。

units.excerpt: I, on the other hand, won't be on any tours anytime soon...
units.zh: 至於我，短期內就不會上任何tour了……

units.excerpt: They should add my name!
units.zh: 宣傳應加入 Atkinson 的姓名。

units.excerpt: There should be a little reminder about what I'm most famous for as well.
units.zh: 宣傳亦應簡短提醒觀眾 Atkinson 最著名的成就。

units.excerpt: I'll send this chat to Avery for the future promotions.
units.zh: Atkinson 會把對話傳給 Avery，供日後宣傳使用。

units.excerpt: I heard about your incident in Sydney Harbour.
units.zh: Atkinson 聽聞悉尼港意外。

units.excerpt: I hope the tabloid newspapers didn't make a mountain out of a molehill.
units.zh: 他希望小報沒有把事情誇大。

units.excerpt: Were any passengers hurt?
units.zh: 有沒有乘客受傷？

units.excerpt: Yes, include the reminder.
units.zh: 要把 Atkinson 最著名的事蹟加進宣傳。

units.excerpt: No passengers onboard.
units.zh: 船上沒有乘客。

units.excerpt: It was not a cruise.
units.zh: 當時並非進行載客航程。

units.excerpt: We were mainly out there to train new crew members.
units.zh: 船隻出航主要為訓練新船員。

units.excerpt: The next Whale Watching Cruise was cancelled.
units.zh: 下一班賞鯨航程已取消。

units.excerpt: The company is putting together an additional compensation package as I type.
units.zh: 公司當時正在擬定額外補償方案。

units.excerpt: That day, we had also planned to scout the whale migration routes.
units.zh: 那一天，我們原本也打算去勘察鯨魚遷徙路線。

units.excerpt: We wanted to add another 50% to the duration of the cruises starting in May.
units.zh: 公司原想由五月起把航程延長 50%。

units.excerpt: The extra 50% duration has been postponed until the June and July cruises because of the accident.
units.zh: 因意外，延長 50% 的安排改到六月及七月航程。

units.excerpt: Well, all's well that ends well. I'm just happy you're all OK.
units.zh: 總算有個好結局。我只是很高興你們全部都沒事。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: Sent: Tuesday 2nd April 09:32AM
units.zh: Shane Lee寄給Avery Goh的電郵」 ／ 「4月2日早上9:32

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: Subject: Compensation for participants of cancelled Sydney Whale Watching Cruise
units.zh: 主旨：給已取消Sydney Whale Watching Cruise參加者的補償

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: The accident with the catamaran is an absolute disaster.
units.zh: 雙體船意外是一場徹底的災難。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: Priority one is that the participants of the cancelled cruise keep booking with us.
units.zh: 首要任務是讓被取消航程的參加者繼續向我們訂購。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: We're working out a killer compensation package, in addition to what we've already announced, that'll hopefully mean they won't even dream of choosing another cruise provider.
units.zh: 我們正在制訂一套很強的補償方案，連同我們已公布的安排，希望令他們連轉用其他cruise公司都不會想。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: Tell them exactly how much we value our customers.
units.zh: 跟進電郵要明確表示公司十分重視客戶。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: Let them know about the compensation package.
units.zh: 跟進電郵要交代補償方案。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: Word will get around and that'll bring in new customers as well.
units.zh: 口碑會傳出去，這也會帶來新客。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: It's particularly bad timing as we're trying to push hard on promoting the new Adventure Fishing Tour.
units.zh: 偏偏現在正是我們大力宣傳新的Adventure Fishing Tour的時候，時機尤其糟。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: Let's try to make it an even better deal; we will now include a free buffet lunch as part of the tour package.
units.zh: 我們來把它變成更吸引的套餐；我們現在會把免費自助午餐加入tour package。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: Mention this in any new advertisements.
units.zh: 要在所有新廣告提及免費自助餐。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: We've hooked up with the caterers at Chez Poisson.
units.zh: 公司原先安排 Chez Poisson 供應自助餐。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: The buffet will include tuna, scallops, and lobster.
units.zh: 自助餐會供應吞拿魚、帶子和龍蝦。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: There will be a break from the Tour on Christmas Day.
units.zh: 旅程在聖誕節當日暫停。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: Keep that in the promotions.
units.zh: 宣傳必須保留這項休息日資料。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: I want to book the pop band Bubblegum.
units.zh: Shane 想預訂流行樂隊 Bubblegum。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: The band would perform live music on the yacht.
units.zh: 樂隊原本會在遊艇上現場演奏。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: Get them to confirm, then add this to the promotions.
units.zh: 要先取得樂隊確認，才加入宣傳。

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: They'll reel in a boatload of new customers — ha!
units.zh: 他們一定能釣來一大船新客——哈！

units.section: Shane Lee email and booking calendar
units.excerpt: Cheers, / Shane
units.zh: 祝好／ Shane

units.zh: 你的全新頂級豪華遊艇正等着你」 ／ 「2023-2026型號——今天就到附近展廳參觀！

units.excerpt: D69X
units.zh: D69X

units.excerpt: The D69X has the distinction of being the most fuel-efficient luxury yacht in the world, offering huge savings over long distances.
units.zh: D69X是全球最省油的豪華遊艇，長距離航行可帶來很大節省。

units.excerpt: This pocket-rocket hits the magical top speed of 55 knots...
units.zh: 這艘小鋼炮最高時速可達55海里……

units.excerpt: The D69X also has an oversized terrace, perfect for relaxing.
units.zh: D69X也有加大露台，非常適合放鬆。

units.excerpt: D79X
units.zh: D79X

units.excerpt: The D79X. It's finally here, the long-awaited sister ship to the D69X.
units.zh: D79X終於來了，是期待已久、與D69X同系的姊妹船。

units.excerpt: You'll see why the 'supercar of the sea' is a nickname that sticks, a whole 10 knots faster than its sister ship!
units.zh: 你會明白為何它被稱為『海上超跑』，因為它比姊妹船整整快10海里！

units.excerpt: We've kept the popular terrace from the D69X, but with the added luxury of a built-in spa.
units.zh: 我們保留了D69X受歡迎的露台，並加入內置spa的額外豪華享受。

units.excerpt: There is no better five-star cruiser.
units.zh: 沒有比它更好的五星級巡航艇了。

units.excerpt: D79XF Fishing Cruiser
units.zh: D79XF釣魚巡航艇

units.excerpt: We know you - and your guests - love to fish in the lap of luxury...
units.zh: 我們知道你和你的客人都喜歡在豪華之中享受釣魚……

units.excerpt: With a top speed of 70 knots, could this become the new “supercar of the sea”?!?
units.zh: 最高時速達 70 節，這會否成為新的「海上超跑」？

units.excerpt: But shhh... it's a secret: see the brand new D79XF at the 2025 Luxury Yacht Expo; sales begin in 2026.
units.zh: 但這仍是秘密：D79XF 會在 2025 Luxury Yacht Expo 亮相，並於 2026 年開始發售。

units.excerpt: Minutes of World City Travel Staff Meeting
units.zh: World City Travel員工會議紀錄

units.excerpt: Date and time: Wednesday 10th April, 10am / Venue: Main Office Conference Room / Chairperson: Shane Lee, CEO / Members: Avery Goh, Manager / Captain Moby / Secretary: Nico Lin
units.zh: 日期時間： 4月10日星期三上午10時／地點：總公司會議室／主席： Shane Lee ／成員： Avery Goh 、 Captain Moby ／秘書： Nico Lin

units.excerpt: Mr Lee announced that he'd called this special meeting to discuss the results of the investigation into the catamaran incident which led to the cancellation of the Sydney Whale Watching Cruise.
units.zh: Mr Lee表示他召開這次特別會議，是要討論導致Sydney Whale Watching Cruise取消的catamaran incident調查結果。

units.excerpt: Ms Goh stated that the Review Board had interviewed everyone onboard the catamaran at the time of the incident and had also inspected the damage to the catamaran.
units.zh: Ms Goh表示，調查委員會已訪問事發時船上所有人，亦檢查了雙體船的損毀情況。

units.excerpt: The Review Board had ruled that Captain Moby's actions kept the crew onboard safe.
units.zh: 調查委員會裁定Captain Moby的行動保障了船上船員安全。

units.excerpt: Ms Goh announced that Captain Moby, according to the Review Board, had been instrumental in minimising damage to the catamaran.
units.zh: Ms Goh宣布，按調查委員會所說， Captain Moby在減低雙體船損毀方面起了關鍵作用。

units.excerpt: Captain Moby expressed relief at the results and that he planned to return to work at the end of the month.
units.zh: Captain Moby對結果表示鬆一口氣，並計劃在月底復工。

units.excerpt: Mr Lee agreed that Captain Moby could now return to work after a well-deserved break.
units.zh: Mr Lee同意Captain Moby經過應得的休息後可以復工。

units.excerpt: He also voiced concerns that World City Travel needed to do more to compensate the participants of the cancelled cruise to ensure they would continue to use the company when booking tours.
units.zh: 他亦表示， World City Travel需要做更多來補償取消航程的參加者，確保他們以後訂tour時仍會使用本公司。

units.excerpt: Ms Goh agreed that the company needed to do more to compensate the participants.
units.zh: Avery 同意公司需要增加補償。

units.excerpt: She suggested that participants be given the choice of another cruise in this migration season as part of the compensation package.
units.zh: 她建議讓參加者在今個遷徙季節另選一次航程作補償。

units.excerpt: Captain Moby concurred as this would allow these participants to experience a World City Travel cruise.
units.zh: Captain Moby同意，因為這樣可讓這些參加者真正體驗到World City Travel的cruise。

units.excerpt: He also insisted it be emphasised that the cruise would be complimentary.
units.zh: Moby 船長堅持要強調替代航程完全免費。

units.excerpt: This was agreed to by all.
units.zh: 與會者全體同意免費航程安排。

units.excerpt: However, he suggested that the booking calendar be consulted first before contacting participants, to ensure availability.
units.zh: 不過，他建議在聯絡參加者前，先查閱booking calendar，以確保有位。

units.excerpt: Booking availability for this season should be clearly communicated to the participants.
units.zh: 要向參加者清楚交代本季可預訂時段。

units.excerpt: The change in cruise duration should be clearly communicated to the participants.
units.zh: 亦要清楚交代航程時長改動。

units.excerpt: He also added that participants should be informed of the details of the available cruises.
units.zh: 他又補充，參加者應獲告知可選航程的細節。

units.excerpt: Ms Goh suggested that participants should be referred to the company website for the itineraries.
units.zh: Ms Goh建議把參加者轉介到公司網站查看行程安排。

units.excerpt: Mr Lee made the announcement that Chez Poisson could no longer provide the buffet for the Adventure Fishing Tour.
units.zh: Mr Lee宣布Chez Poisson不能再為Adventure Fishing Tour提供自助餐。

units.excerpt: iSea Caterers would take over.
units.zh: iSea Caterers 會接手供應自助餐。

units.excerpt: iSea Caterers had committed to serve the same dishes.
units.zh: iSea 承諾供應相同菜式。

units.excerpt: The new Tour schedule would now start on 6th December.
units.zh: 新團最新安排改於 12 月 6 日開始。

units.excerpt: The Tour would finish on the same date announced previously.
units.zh: 新團結束日期維持先前公布的日期。

units.excerpt: The contractual break day would not be affected.
units.zh: 合約規定的休息日不受新時間表影響。

units.excerpt: Dr David Atkinson intervened about the live music.
units.zh: Atkinson 就現場音樂安排提出意見。

units.excerpt: The live music on the yacht had been cancelled.
units.zh: 遊艇上的現場音樂已取消。

units.excerpt: Dr Atkinson's concern was that it would scare away the fish.
units.zh: Dr Atkinson擔心現場音樂會把魚嚇走。

units.excerpt: The meeting ended at 11:45am.
units.zh: 會議於上午11:45結束。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: Extract from World City Travel company handbook
units.zh: World City Travel 公司手冊節錄

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: Chapter 3: Contents of an incident report
units.zh: World City Travel公司手冊節錄」 ／ 「第三章：事故報告的內容

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: When writing an incident report, employees should include the following to ensure a comprehensive record is kept for future reference.
units.zh: 撰寫incident report時，員工應包括以下內容，以確保留下完整紀錄供日後參考。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: Generally, a report should cover factual information, including but not limited to details such as the date and time of the relevant incident, location of the incident, and what was involved in the incident. This is to ensure readers have all the necessary background information.
units.zh: 一般而言，報告應涵蓋事實資料，包括事故日期和時間、地點及事件內容，讓讀者掌握所需背景。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: A report should explain the reason(s) why those involved were present at the location, and any known cause(s) of the incident, no matter how preliminary. Such information is usually available after initial investigations and interviews, or taken from other relevant sources.
units.zh: 報告應解釋涉事者為何會在該地點，以及事故的任何已知成因，即使只是初步成因也應寫明。這類資料通常可從初步調查、訪談或其他相關來源取得。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: If a Review Board investigation has been conducted, the report should clearly present the results, including any relevant comments or evaluations made by the Review Board. If appropriate, the report should assign any blame or responsibility for the incident.
units.zh: 如已進行Review Board調查，報告應清楚呈現其結果，包括任何相關評論或評估。如有需要，報告應指出事故責任歸屬。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: Biography of David Atkinson on the World City Travel website
units.zh: World City Travel網站上的David Atkinson簡介

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: Dr David Atkinson was born in Taunton, Somerset in 1967.
units.zh: David Atkinson於1967年在Somerset的Taunton出生。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: As the son of two academics, he had an interest in aquatic life from an early age, eventually studying Marine Biology at the universities of Oxford, Liverpool and the Sorbonne in Paris, specialising in migration.
units.zh: 作為兩位學者之子，他自小已對水生生物有興趣，其後在Oxford 、 Liverpool和巴黎Sorbonne修讀海洋生物學，專攻遷徙。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: Most people will know Dr Atkinson from his TV wildlife documentaries.
units.zh: 大多數人認識Dr Atkinson，是因為他的野生生態電視紀錄片。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: Who can forget 'The Life of Whales'? Screened in over 80 countries and 20 different languages, this 2013 series stands as his most famous work and is the natural history breakthrough that really put his name on the map.
units.zh: 誰會忘記《The Life of Whales》？這套 2013 年系列在超過 80 個國家以 20 種語言播放，是他最著名、令他聲名大噪的自然歷史作品。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: We're proud to say that Dr Atkinson has been working with World City Travel since 2019.
units.zh: 我們很自豪地說， Dr Atkinson自2019年起已與World City Travel合作。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: 'I love the camaraderie here. Everyone gets along well. On top of that, we really do provide some excellent travel products,' said Dr Atkinson.
units.zh: 『我很喜歡這裡的團隊氣氛，大家相處很好。再者，我們確實提供出色的旅遊產品。』 Dr Atkinson說。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: Many do not know that Dr Atkinson is also a keen wildlife photographer.
units.zh: 很多人未必知道， Dr Atkinson也是一位熱心的野生攝影師。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: His dramatic 'Aqua Vita' photo prints, of aquatic mammals in the wild, are among the most popular in our online shop and would light up any home or office.
units.zh: 他的《Aqua Vita》野生水生哺乳類照片印刷品在網店很受歡迎，適合家居或辦公室。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: One print is given free of charge to all of those with lifetime membership of World City Travel.
units.zh: World City Travel 終身會員可免費獲贈一幅照片印刷品。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: Dr Atkinson is a keen yachtsman.
units.zh: Atkinson 熱愛遊艇。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: His current favourite is the 'supercar of the sea'.
units.zh: 他目前最喜歡的是「海上超跑」。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: He's delighted that this will be the vessel to carry him and our guests on the new Adventure Fishing Tour.
units.zh: 他很高興這艘船將會載着他與我們的客人，參與新的Adventure Fishing Tour。

units.section: Company handbook and David Atkinson biography
units.excerpt: Likewise, we're delighted to have Dr Atkinson on board!
units.zh: 同樣地，我們也很高興Dr Atkinson加入旅程！

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Morning everyone. Welcome to our monthly Zoom meeting. How are we all doing today?
units.zh: 各位早晨，歡迎參加每月 Zoom 會議。大家今天好嗎？

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Morning Shane. I am feeling great so far. Thank you.
units.zh: Shane 早晨。我目前很好，謝謝。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We have quite a bit going on at the moment, so it’s been a busy period for me.
units.zh: 目前有很多事情要處理，所以 Avery 最近很忙。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: The Guided Nature Walk at the Hong Kong Wetland Park is coming up soon.
units.zh: 香港濕地公園導賞自然步行團即將舉行。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: The Guided Nature Walk will be held on the 27th of April at 10am.
units.zh: 導賞自然步行團於 4 月 27 日上午 10 時舉行。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: The walk will be 2 hours long.
units.zh: 步行團長兩小時。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: The meeting venue this time will be the visitor centre.
units.zh: 今次集合地點是訪客中心。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We’ll email all the details to the participants soon.
units.zh: 稍後會把所有詳情電郵給參加者。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We are changing the time of the Bird Watching Tour from 7:30am to 9:30am.
units.zh: 觀鳥團時間由上午 7 時 30 分改為 9 時 30 分。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Not enough people are signing up to join the Bird Watching Tour.
units.zh: 觀鳥團報名人數不足。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We’ve had complaints from participants in previous tours that the Bird Watching Tour starts too early.
units.zh: 過往參加者投訴觀鳥團開始得太早。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: I was referring to the catamaran accident in Sydney Harbour.
units.zh: Shane 指的是悉尼港雙體船意外。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: How’s the Review Board’s investigation on Captain Moby going? Have they reached a conclusion yet?
units.zh: Avery 詢問檢討委員會是否已就 Moby 船長得出結論。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: The conclusion is that Captain Moby is not at fault.
units.zh: 檢討委員會的結論是 Moby 船長沒有過失。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: The Review Board has also insisted that we explicitly mention in the incident report that Captain Moby was extremely professional in handling the situation.
units.zh: 檢討委員會要求意外報告明確寫出 Moby 船長處理事件時極為專業。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: He is indeed “extremely professional”.
units.zh: David 重複認同 Moby 船長非常專業。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: The accident also caused the cancellation of the next Sydney Whale Watching Cruise.
units.zh: 意外亦令下一班悉尼賞鯨船取消。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We need to write a follow-up email to them. We should talk about compensation.
units.zh: 公司要向受影響參加者發跟進電郵並交代補償。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: As part of the additional compensation package, on top of what we’ve pledged already, we’ll be giving participants of the cancelled cruise lifetime membership of World City Travel.
units.zh: 除已承諾的補償外，取消航程的參加者會獲 World City Travel 終身會籍。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: With lifetime membership, participants can get a 30% discount on all tours that we provide. For life!
units.zh: 終身會員一生可享公司所有旅行團七折。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We need to continue promoting the new Insects and Reptiles Exhibition.
units.zh: 公司仍要宣傳新的昆蟲及爬蟲展覽。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We have two very special dragonflies people will encounter at the exhibition.
units.zh: 展覽有兩種特別蜻蜓。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We will have the Red Baller at the exhibition.
units.zh: 展覽會有 Red Baller。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: People will get to see the Blue Tail.
units.zh: 參加者會看到 Blue Tail。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: The participant with the best dragonfly photo wins 500 dollars.
units.zh: 最佳蜻蜓照片參賽者可贏得 500 元。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Our new Adventure Fishing Tour starts soon in Sydney.
units.zh: 新的 Adventure Fishing Tour 即將在悉尼開始。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: During the Adventure Fishing Tour, the yacht will stop at two white sand beaches.
units.zh: 遊艇會在兩個白沙灘停靠。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Participants can catch shellfish at these stops.
units.zh: 參加者可在這些停靠點捕捉貝類。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We chose these two beaches especially for that.
units.zh: 選擇這兩個沙灘正是因為可以捕捉貝類。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Only that we are very lucky to have Avery with us!
units.zh: David 說公司很幸運有 Avery。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Let’s get to work and prepare the necessary documents.
units.zh: Shane 叫大家開始準備所需文件。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We’ll meet again on Zoom next month.
units.zh: 他們下月再開 Zoom 會議。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Goodbye for now.
units.zh: 暫時再見。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: That is the end of the listening component of this paper.
units.zh: 聆聽部分到此結束。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: You will now have one hour and fifteen minutes to complete the written tasks in either Part B1 or Part B2.
units.zh: 考生有一小時十五分鐘完成 B1 或 B2 的書面任務。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: April 27th at 10am. A very sensible time to meet.
units.zh: 4 月 27 日上午 10 時；這是很合理的集合時間。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Is the meeting venue still the main entrance of the park?
units.zh: 集合地點仍是公園正門嗎？

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We decided that the main entrance is much too busy.
units.zh: 他們認為正門太繁忙。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: I agree: the visitor centre is a much better choice.
units.zh: Shane 同意訪客中心是較好的選擇。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Shall we move on to the Bird Watching Tour at the Hong Kong Botanical Gardens?
units.zh: 他們轉到香港植物公園觀鳥團。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We are planning to write an email to Peter Chan, the manager of the Botanical Gardens.
units.zh: 他們計劃寫電郵給植物公園經理 Peter Chan。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: This is a tour we tend to start bright and early in the morning. 7:30am, isn’t it?
units.zh: 觀鳥團向來早上 7 時 30 分開始。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: I believe that’s not the case anymore. Am I right, Avery?
units.zh: David 認為舊時間已改，並向 Avery 確認。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We need to inform Peter Chan of this change in the email.
units.zh: 電郵要通知 Peter Chan 時間改動。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: That’s quite a big change. I’m sure Peter will want to know why.
units.zh: Shane 認為改動很大，Peter 會想知道原因。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We definitely want to increase the number of people signing up.
units.zh: 公司想增加觀鳥團報名人數。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: So, you think this is because the Tour starts too early?
units.zh: Shane 問是否因觀鳥團開始得太早。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: If we’ve had complaints that the Tour starts too early, then changing the time is the right decision.
units.zh: Shane 因早開始的投訴而確認改時間。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: That’s settled, then. Anything else I need to know about the tour?
units.zh: Shane 表示安排已定，並問還有沒有其他資料。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: No, I think that’s it.
units.zh: Avery 表示沒有其他資料。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Captain Moby is a good friend and I heard a little bit about it from him.
units.zh: Atkinson 說 Moby 是好友，曾從他那裏聽過意外。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: The catamaran is such a beautiful boat. I hope the damage wasn’t too bad.
units.zh: Atkinson 覺得船很漂亮，並希望損毀不嚴重。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: I’ve been sent the results of the Review Board’s investigation.
units.zh: Shane 已收到檢討委員會的調查結果。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: He will be so relieved to hear that.
units.zh: David 認為 Moby 得知沒有過失後會鬆一口氣。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: He must have done an amazing job for them to say that.
units.zh: David 因委員會評語而認為 Moby 表現出色。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We’re lucky to have him with our company.
units.zh: Shane 說公司很幸運有 Moby。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Reputation is everything in our business.
units.zh: Shane 認為商譽對公司極重要。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: I don’t want people to have a bad impression of us because of this incident.
units.zh: Shane 不希望客人因意外對公司留下壞印象。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: I want to go the extra mile for this.
units.zh: Shane 想為補償多做一步。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Lifetime membership of World City Travel? What does that include?
units.zh: David 問終身會籍包括甚麼。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Thirty percent off is an amazing deal. How can I get lifetime membership?
units.zh: David 稱七折很吸引，並開玩笑問如何加入。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Hopefully that will help us put all this behind us.
units.zh: Shane 希望補償有助公司走出事件。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: David, you had an idea about the dragonflies in the exhibition. Can you tell us a bit more?
units.zh: Shane 請 David 介紹展覽蜻蜓構思。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Generally people see a lot of dragonflies around Hong Kong, especially in parks.
units.zh: 香港公園一般可見很多蜻蜓。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: You can see pictures of them on the website.
units.zh: 網站可看到兩種蜻蜓的照片。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Red Baller and Blue Tail are very interesting names for very interesting dragonflies.
units.zh: Shane 覺得兩個蜻蜓名稱很有趣。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: To encourage people to look out for them, we will also have a photo-taking competition.
units.zh: 展覽會舉行攝影比賽，鼓勵參加者尋找蜻蜓。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: This should add a little excitement for the participants.
units.zh: David 認為攝影比賽會增加趣味。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Last time, we discussed adding stops along the route. What became of that, Avery?
units.zh: Shane 問先前討論的停靠點安排結果。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Two white sand beaches? Any particular reason for this choice?
units.zh: Shane 問為何選兩個白沙灘。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Why not on some sort of outlying islands?
units.zh: Shane 問為何不選離島。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Choosing places where participants can catch shellfish is very clever.
units.zh: Shane 認為選擇可捕捉貝類的地點很聰明。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: I’m sure they’ll love this idea.
units.zh: Shane 相信參加者會喜歡這個構思。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Anything to add, David?
units.zh: Shane 問 David 有沒有補充。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: We’ll meet again on Zoom next month, but let’s keep in touch in the meantime.
units.zh: 他們下月再開 Zoom 會議，其間保持聯絡。

units.section: Zoom meeting (third-party reproduction of official tapescript)
units.excerpt: Goodbye!
units.zh: 再見！
